# Prime Haven

> Prime Haven is a freelance design and technology agency in Ghana (Greater Accra), serving clients in Ghana and worldwide. We deliver web development, UI/UX design, graphic design, mobile app development, motion graphics, video editing, social media management and IT solutions through a vetted network of Ghanaian professionals.

Businesses hire Prime Haven for end-to-end project delivery (research, design, development, testing and support) or to work with vetted freelance designers and developers. Pricing is quoted per project in USD and Ghana Cedis (GH₵). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/primehaven_tech

## Pages

- [Home](https://primehaven.tech/): Services, process, team and client work.
- [Our Story](https://primehaven.tech/our-story): Who we are and why Prime Haven exists.
- [Portfolio](https://primehaven.tech/portfolio): Case studies across UI/UX, branding, graphic design and web development.
- [Start a project](https://primehaven.tech/start-project): Brief submission and quote request.
- [Blog](https://primehaven.tech/blog): News and updates.
- [Apply](https://primehaven.tech/apply): Join Prime Haven as a vetted freelance professional.

## Hiring tracks

Freelancers in Ghana can apply to join each track via https://primehaven.tech/hiring/{track}, e.g. [Graphic Design track](https://primehaven.tech/hiring/graphic-design).
